page.title: thatは導く、限定詞は受ける

analysis.summaryJa: thatは遠くの物を指すだけでなく、動詞が表す考えの内容、名詞の具体的な中身、名詞を後ろから説明する節へ注意を導く。一方some・any・both・eachなど多くの限定詞は、既知の名詞を省いて代名詞的に単独使用でき、特定集合の一部を示すときはX of＋the／these／代名詞を用いる。noは単独にできずnoneへ形を変える。
grammarPoints: 動詞の内容を導く接続詞that
同格のthat節と関係代名詞that
visualEvidence: THATの矢印が物・考えの内容・名詞の中身・後ろの説明へ分岐する図
some booksからsomeなど名詞が消えても残るカード
X of＋特定グループの枠
単独noは不可でnoneを使うという警告
commonTraps: 接続詞thatと指示語thatを混同する
同格that節を関係節と誤認する
特定集合の前でofを落とす
ofの後ろに限定のない裸複数を置く

questions.prompt: The director confirmed ------- the new branch would open in May.

choices.D: some

questions.translationJa: 部長は新支店が5月に開業することを確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: confirmedの内容となる完全な節を導く接続詞thatが必要です。

questions.prompt: The report ------- arrived this morning contains the final figures.

choices.D: some

questions.translationJa: 今朝届いた報告書には最終数値が記載されています。
questions.explanationJa: 先行詞reportを後ろから説明し、関係節内の主語になる関係代名詞thatです。

questions.prompt: The news ------- the contract had been renewed relieved the team.

choices.D: that

questions.translationJa: 契約が更新されたという知らせにチームは安心しました。
questions.explanationJa: newsの具体的な中身を完全な節で説明する同格のthatです。

questions.prompt: The samples on this tray are defective, but ------- over there passed inspection.

choices.D: any

questions.translationJa: このトレーのサンプルは不良ですが、向こうのものは検査に合格しました。
questions.explanationJa: 遠くの複数samplesを名詞なしで受ける指示代名詞thoseが適切です。

questions.prompt: We need more labels; do you have -------?

choices.D: much

questions.translationJa: ラベルがもっと必要です。何枚かありますか。
questions.explanationJa: 既出の複数labelsを繰り返さず、疑問文でanyを単独使用します。

questions.prompt: Four routes were proposed, and ------- are suitable for large trucks.

choices.D: much

questions.translationJa: 4つの経路が提案され、そのうちいくつかは大型トラックに適しています。
questions.explanationJa: 既知の複数routesの一部をsomeが単独で受けます。

questions.prompt: We tested the two microphones, and ------- worked clearly.

choices.D: every

questions.translationJa: 2本のマイクを試したところ、両方とも明瞭に作動しました。
questions.explanationJa: 既出の二つを名詞なしで受け、複数動詞workedと結ぶbothです。

questions.prompt: The six desks were checked; ------- of them needs a new cable.

choices.D: each

questions.translationJa: 6台の机を確認したところ、それぞれに新しいケーブルが必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 特定集合themの各構成員をEach ofで表し、単数動詞needsを取ります。

questions.prompt: The survey offered three dates, but ------- of them suited the trainer.

choices.D: neither

questions.translationJa: 調査では3つの日程を提示しましたが、講師に都合のよいものは一つもありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 三つ以上の特定集合をゼロとして単独で受けるnone ofを使います。

questions.prompt: The assumption ------- all clients prefer email may be incorrect.

choices.D: those

questions.translationJa: すべての顧客がメールを好むという想定は誤っているかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: assumptionの中身を示す完全な節を同格thatが導きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting a belief.

choices.A: We believe that is the revised plan practical.
choices.B: We believe that the revised plan is practical.
choices.C: We believe what the revised plan is practical.
choices.D: We believe those the revised plan is practical.

questions.translationJa: 改訂案は実用的だと私たちは考えています。
questions.explanationJa: believeの内容をS＋Vの語順の完全なthat節で示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence identifying a document.

choices.A: The form that it requires a signature is on the counter.
choices.B: The form what requires a signature is on the counter.
choices.C: The form that requires a signature are on the counter.
choices.D: The form that requires a signature is on the counter.

questions.translationJa: 署名を必要とする用紙はカウンターにあります。
questions.explanationJa: thatが関係節の主語なのでitを重ねず、単数formにisを合わせます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence explaining the content of a rumor.

choices.A: The rumor that the store would close proved false.
choices.B: The rumor that would close the store proved false.
choices.C: The rumor what the store would close proved false.
choices.D: The rumor that the store would close it proved false.

questions.translationJa: その店が閉店するといううわさは誤りだと分かりました。
questions.explanationJa: that以下はrumorの内容を示す完全な同格節です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a determiner without repeating a noun.

choices.A: We ordered ten chairs, but only no arrived.
choices.B: We ordered ten chairs, but only every arrived.
choices.C: We ordered ten chairs, but only some arrived.
choices.D: We ordered ten chairs, but only some chairs they arrived.

questions.translationJa: 椅子を10脚注文しましたが、届いたのは一部だけでした。
questions.explanationJa: someが既出のchairsを単独で受け、名詞や代名詞を重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about two known alternatives.

choices.A: The two entrances are unlocked, so you may use every.
choices.B: The two entrances are unlocked, so you may use no.
choices.C: The two entrances are unlocked, so you may use either entrance it.
choices.D: The two entrances are unlocked, so you may use either.

questions.translationJa: 2つの入口は解錠されているので、どちらを使ってもかまいません。
questions.explanationJa: eitherが既知の二つのentrancesを単独で受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence selecting part of a specific group.

choices.A: Some of applicants have prior experience.
choices.B: Some of the applicants have prior experience.
choices.C: Some the applicants have prior experience.
choices.D: Some of the applicant has prior experience, meaning several.

questions.translationJa: その応募者たちのうち何人かは経験があります。
questions.explanationJa: 特定集合the applicantsの一部はsome of the＋複数で示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence referring to all members of a pair.

choices.A: Both of they have confirmed attendance.
choices.C: Both of them have confirmed attendance.
choices.D: Every of them have confirmed attendance.

questions.translationJa: 彼ら2人は両方とも出席を確認済みです。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞ofの後ろは目的格themで、both of themは複数扱いです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence meaning zero items without a following noun.

choices.A: We requested three quotes, but none arrived.
choices.B: We requested three quotes, but no arrived.
choices.C: We requested three quotes, but not arrived.
choices.D: We requested three quotes, but none quote arrived.

questions.translationJa: 見積もりを3件依頼しましたが、一件も届きませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞を伴わずゼロを受けるときはnoではなくnoneを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with each of.

choices.A: Each of these devices have a warranty label.
choices.B: Every of these devices has a warranty label.
choices.C: Each these devices has a warranty label.
choices.D: Each of these devices has a warranty label.

questions.translationJa: これらの装置には一台ずつ保証ラベルがあります。
questions.explanationJa: each of＋限定された複数集合は単数動詞hasを取ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence contrasting that functions.

choices.A: I know that the package that it arrived yesterday is yours.
choices.B: I know that the package that arrived yesterday is yours.
choices.C: I know what the package that arrived yesterday is yours.
choices.D: I know those the package what arrived yesterday is yours.

questions.translationJa: 昨日届いた荷物があなたのものだと知っています。
questions.explanationJa: 最初のthatはknowの内容節、二つ目はpackageを説明する関係代名詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I heard that the meeting was canceled."

choices.A: I heard the canceled meeting itself speak.
choices.B: I canceled the meeting after hearing it.
choices.C: I heard which meeting to schedule.
choices.D: I heard the news of the meeting’s cancellation.

questions.translationJa: 会議中止の知らせを聞きました。
questions.explanationJa: that節はheardの内容を示し、名詞句the news of ...で言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The claim that the device is safe needs evidence."

choices.A: A safe device made a claim.
choices.B: The claim’s content is that the device is safe, and it needs evidence.
choices.C: The claim identifies a device that needs evidence.
choices.D: Evidence has already proved the claim.

questions.translationJa: その装置は安全だという主張には根拠が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 同格that節はclaimの具体的内容を説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The files that are encrypted need passwords."

choices.A: All files are encrypted and password-free.
choices.D: The files need to encrypt passwords.

questions.translationJa: 暗号化されているファイルにはパスワードが必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 関係節that are encryptedは形容詞encryptedで短く言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We have batteries, but we need more." "I have some."

choices.A: The speaker has an unspecified number of batteries.
choices.C: The speaker has every battery in existence.
choices.D: The speaker has only battery chargers.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は電池をいくつか持っています。
questions.explanationJa: 単独someは文脈上既出の複数batteriesを受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Which of the two rooms is free?" "Both."

choices.B: The two rooms are both free.
choices.D: Every room in the building is free.

questions.translationJa: 2つの部屋は両方とも空いています。
questions.explanationJa: 単独bothは直前の二つのroomsを受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Some of these orders are urgent."

choices.A: Orders in general are all urgent.
choices.B: None of these orders is urgent.
choices.C: One unspecified order outside the set is urgent.
choices.D: A portion of this specific set of orders is urgent.

questions.translationJa: これらの注文という特定集合の一部が緊急です。
questions.explanationJa: some of theseは境界の見える集合の一部を選びます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Each of us has a key."

choices.A: Every person in our group has a key.
choices.B: Our group shares one key only.
choices.C: No one in our group has a key.
choices.D: Some people outside our group have keys.

questions.translationJa: 私たちの一人ひとりが鍵を持っています。
questions.explanationJa: each of usは特定集団usの各構成員を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "None of the printers works."

choices.C: No printer in the specified group works.
choices.D: Printers outside the group cannot work.

questions.translationJa: そのプリンター群の中で作動するものは一台もありません。
questions.explanationJa: none of the printersは特定集合内の数量ゼロを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "That over there is our shuttle."

choices.A: The distant vehicle being indicated is our shuttle.
choices.B: This vehicle beside me is our shuttle.
choices.C: All distant vehicles are our shuttles.
choices.D: Our shuttle indicates a distant place.

questions.translationJa: 向こうにある、指し示している車両が私たちの送迎車です。
questions.explanationJa: 単独thatは話し手から遠い一つの物を指します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The fact that sales rose pleased investors."

choices.B: The fact was an investor that rose.
choices.C: Sales rose because investors were displeased.
choices.D: Investors were pleased by the fact of rising sales.

questions.translationJa: 売上が伸びたという事実を投資家は喜びました。
questions.explanationJa: 同格that節がfactの内容を示し、of＋動名詞相当で言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: The manager reviewed the forecast. She concluded ------- demand would increase next quarter.

choices.D: some

questions.translationJa: 部長は予測を確認し、次四半期に需要が増えると結論づけました。
questions.explanationJa: concludedの内容を完全な節で示す接続詞thatが必要です。

questions.prompt: Several boxes arrived today. The box ------- contains replacement parts should go to maintenance.

choices.D: some

questions.translationJa: 今日いくつか箱が届きました。交換部品が入っている箱は保守部門へ回してください。
questions.explanationJa: boxを特定し、関係節内の主語となるthatが適切です。

questions.prompt: The announcement surprised everyone. The announcement ------- the office would relocate was unexpected.

choices.D: that

questions.translationJa: 発表は全員を驚かせました。事務所が移転するという発表は予想外でした。
questions.explanationJa: announcementの具体的内容を同格that節が説明します。

questions.prompt: We have five spare adapters in this drawer. You may take ------- if your team needs extras.

choices.D: much

questions.translationJa: この引き出しに予備アダプターが5個あります。チームで追加分が必要なら、いくつか取ってかまいません。
questions.explanationJa: 既出の複数adaptersを単独someが受け、不特定の一部を表します。

questions.prompt: Two conference rooms were reserved, and ------- have video equipment.

choices.D: much

questions.translationJa: 会議室を2室予約し、両方に映像設備があります。
questions.explanationJa: 既出の二つのroomsを単独bothが受け、複数動詞haveと結び付きます。

questions.prompt: The courier brought several envelopes. Are ------- for the finance team?

choices.D: much

questions.translationJa: 配達員が封筒を何通か持ってきました。財務チーム宛てのものはありますか。
questions.explanationJa: 既出複数envelopesを疑問文でanyが単独で受けます。

questions.prompt: The committee considered six designs. Some of ------- were too expensive to produce.

choices.D: those design

questions.translationJa: 委員会は6つのデザインを検討し、そのうちいくつかは製造費が高すぎました。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞ofの後ろで既出designsを受ける目的格themが必要です。

questions.prompt: There are three elevators in this wing, but ------- of them is operating during maintenance.

choices.D: none

questions.translationJa: この棟にはエレベーターが3基ありますが、保守中は一基も動いていません。
questions.explanationJa: 三つの特定集合をゼロで受けるためnone of themを使います。

questions.prompt: The two finalists gave presentations. ------- of the finalists answered every question clearly.

choices.D: Much

questions.translationJa: 最終候補者2人が発表し、両者ともすべての質問に明確に答えました。
questions.explanationJa: 特定の二人全体をBoth of＋複数で受けます。

questions.prompt: The policy contains several exceptions. We understand some, but not -------.

choices.D: much

questions.translationJa: その方針にはいくつか例外があり、一部は理解していますが全部ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: 既出の複数exceptionsを単独allが受け、not allで部分否定を作ります。
